versions.changelog:
part-2-notice-assessment v1.0.1

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No changes to assessment logic or functionality.

Initial release of part-2-notice-assessment: checks SUD program's public notice against 42 CFR Part 2 requirements.

- Assesses only the program’s publicly posted §2.22 patient notice—no evaluation of internal practice.
- Checks the notice for each content element required by §2.22(b); each gap is cited and quoted for auditor/patient verification.
- Flags “element absent” or “insufficient information” based strictly on the face of the posted document.
- Halts assessment if the subject is not a Part 2 program; if no notice is posted, cites §2.22(c)(3)(i) gap.
- Self-contained: includes full regulatory checklist and text for accurate, standalone review.
